ModMetaData.name: Grounded: Realistic Stats Overhaul
ModMetaData.author: DrSeedon
ModMetaData.description:
Realistic stats overhaul with Harmony integration.
Recalculates animal stats from real-world zoological data: body size, speed, lifespan, gestation, litter size, diet, temperature tolerance, meat/leather yield, manhunter chance, market value.
Auto-scales stackLimit for food, leather, and textiles based on item mass.
Differentiates crop economics: potato yields more but rots faster; rice needs warmth; strawberries are a luxury that spoils quickly.
New body types, sounds, and biome spawn rates for vanilla + DLC + mod animals.
Compatible with Combat Extended, Vanilla Animals Expanded, Alpha Animals, Biotech, Odyssey.
